ADD to REQ-466 open_questions / roster note: "Roster fact: every vortex role has exactly one holder (role-ceo = actor-vortex-dirk). With distinct_from on escalate-budget-approval-to-ceo naming escalate-to-ceo, the escalated budget path cannot complete when the same CEO already decided the capacity escalation: it stalls and ends fail-closed (auto-reject-order / terminal) by the E3 timer. items.title: Working rules learned this round
list: Scenario/fixture/test/ changes: run test/letflow/scripts + test/letflow/simulation + the scenario-schema test as well as test/mix (guard test shipped_definitions_variable_schemas caught severity "low")
Queue lock needs the task to be eligible; depends_on cannot be edited; release done closes the GH issue: file the residual BEFORE releasing and put the exception wording in the yaml status

A PROCESS-AUDITOR handoff must carry ORCH-computed digests (sha256 of file bytes), validator_output ([] for a scope without definitions), cross_scope_inputs; the auditor has no shell; do not tell it to read earlier audit reports (independence)
Merge slots are serial and announced by the supervisor; ask before pushing a PR that costs a ~40 min gate
Only qa-uat-env.sh token <user>; never the bare platform mode; nothing printed; QA seed scripts run with the tenant-own admin (TENANT_ADMIN)
